## Quick answers

The questions agents ask before signing up. The full list lives on the FAQ and features pages.
What is PropertyList?
PropertyList is the system Spanish estate agencies run on: one login that replaces the CRM, the MLS, the portal presence, the agency website, the AI marketing tools and the market-data subscriptions an agency would otherwise buy from four or five vendors. It is also the network those tools plug into: list a property once and 1,390+ agents across 1,000+ agencies can sell it with you, while buyers find it on propertylist.es. The AI does the heavy lifting: a listing written from photos and a voice note, buyers matched against the whole market from a pasted client message, and follow-up that keeps working your database long after most agents stop - grounded in notary-verified sale prices, not asking-price guesses. Is PropertyList really free?
The core is free with no limit: the MLS, unlimited listings, team accounts, your MicroSite and the Lead, Seller and Property pipelines. Moving a qualified buyer lead into the Buyer pipeline costs 1 credit, and your first 5 are free. How does PropertyList make money?
Credits, from one prepaid balance - and every charge is optional. Receiving a lead costs nothing: portal enquiries are free for a limited time, and leads from other agents or from your MicroSite are free forever. If you choose to move a qualified buyer into the Buyer pipeline, that is 1 credit, with your first 5 free - and if you never move them, you never pay. The same goes for featuring a listing, property reports, the Rentals Module, the XML feed that puts the whole network's stock on your own website, and the custom Website Builder, which is free to build and preview and only billed once you publish it live. Nothing switches itself on. Listing and selling stay free, so the network keeps growing. Can I get free credits?
Yes. Refer an agency: you earn 20 credits for every agency that signs up through your link, with no cap, and the new agency starts with 10. On top of that, verifying your agency (free, about two minutes) adds another 20 credits and puts the verified badge on your listings. Do I have to leave my current portal or CRM?
No. Import your existing XML feed free and run PropertyList alongside whatever you use today. Pushing your listings out to other portals is free too. How fast can I start?
Minutes. Create the free account (no card), add one property with Instant Listing, and it is live on the MLS and the portal. See the nine-minute walkthrough.

How many hours a week does admin take from you? Tick what you hate doing, drag the hours, get the bill - and the fix for every line on it. Pick your poison ->

Don't want to pay? Earn your credits. Refer an agency and you both get credits - 20 for you, 10 for them, with no limit. Spend them on any of the upgrades above. See how referrals work ->

Visiting the Costa del Sol? See what's on this week. Concerts, festivals, street markets and beach clubs in Marbella, Estepona and Malaga - updated every week. Build your own day plan and drop it straight into your calendar. See what's on ->

Are you an agent? Help shape what we build next. A 2-minute survey - tell us what you want from a property portal, and we'll add 10 credits to your account. Take the 2-min survey ->

# What we offer

PropertyList is the first free MLS built for estate agents in Spain - agent-to-agent collaboration, a public property portal, a CRM and AI tools, all in one place. The essentials are free forever; optional upgrades are paid with credits.

PropertyList is the first free MLS built for estate agents in Spain - agent-to-agent collaboration, a public property portal, a CRM and AI tools, all in one place. Join Andalucia's fastest-growing real estate platform.

## What you get for free

The essentials are free forever - no setup fees, no tied contracts, no hidden costs.

- Unlimited listings on the MLS - share as many properties as you like with the agent network.

- List by voice - create a full listing from photos and a voice note with Instant Listing.

- Free CRM - unlimited contacts, calendar, lead pipeline, document upload, and a contact and property history timeline.

- Branded MicroSite - your own agency mini-website, included.

- Messaging and viewing requests between agents.

- AI property search - buyers find homes by typing in plain language.

- Property alerts - save a client's request and get emailed the moment a match comes online.

- WhatsApp community access, plus distribution to our Facebook pages and groups.

- Unlimited staff accounts for your whole team.

See everything the free plan includes ->

## What you can optionally pay for

Everything paid draws from a single balance of credits - buy them when you like and use them at your own pace. Every paid feature has a free test, and credits you buy never expire.

- Feature a listing - extra visibility on the MLS and the public portal, from 10 credits for 3 days.

- Property-specific market analysis - branded CMA reports with notary-verified prices.

- Website Builder - a full agency website with your listings auto-loaded, from 50 credits/month.

- Instant Content - unlimited AI blog posts and area guides for your site, fully automated with auto-publish or review-first, 30 credits/month.

- XML feed - push every listing to your own website and any other portals you work with.

- Deal pipelines - the Lead, Seller and Property boards are free with no limit. Moving a qualified buyer into the Buyer pipeline costs 1 credit each time, and your first 5 are free. The Tenants board is part of the Rentals Module.

See full pricing ->

## For property developers

Showcase your latest developments to a network of thousands of estate agents, investors and buyers - and list them at no cost. Partner with experienced agents to market and sell your projects faster. Developers list directly at developers.propertylist.es, and there is a developer guide to walk you through it.

Lawyers, architects, plumbers, builders - get noticed by thousands of agents, landlords, buyers and renters. Showcase your services to the right audience and win more qualified leads.

## Credits: one balance for everything

Everything paid on PropertyList draws from a single balance of credits - monthly subscriptions like your website,
and pay-as-you-go extras like market reports. Buy packs when you like; bigger packs are better value. Prices in
euro, VAT added at checkout.

It is only due once the buyer has paid 10% or more towards the property - so you are never out of pocket for marketing that has not converted. And there is no paywall on the agent side: every agent with a PropertyList account gets full access to all developments, free - to share with their clients and sell. Your project reaches the whole network from day one.

## Frequently asked questions

See every feature explained in detail - website builder, XML feeds, Rentals, Market Intelligence, and more - on the Features FAQ page, or see how the CRM pipelines work.

Is PropertyList really free for estate agents?
The core is free with no limit: the MLS, unlimited listings, team accounts, contact management and the Lead, Seller and Property pipelines. The CRM is not 100% free, because moving a qualified buyer lead into the Buyer pipeline costs 1 credit. Your first 5 are free, then it is 1 credit each. Everything else paid is optional: featured listings (10 credits for 3 days), the Rentals Module (50 credits per 30 days, free 30-day trial) or the Website Builder (50 credits a month). Automation & Nurture is free.

How do credits work?
Everything paid on PropertyList draws from a single balance of credits. You buy them in packs - from €20 for 20 credits (€1 each) down to €0.80 per credit on the 1,000 pack - and credits you have bought never expire. Monthly subscriptions (like the Website Builder) and pay-as-you-go features (like market reports) all come from the same balance.

What happens if I run out of credits?
Nothing is lost. If your balance cannot cover a renewal, your custom site pauses and visitors see the standard page while every page and setting is kept safe as a draft. Top up and republish in one click. Turn on Auto-Renew and your balance tops up automatically before each renewal, by the monthly cost of whatever you have switched on, so nothing pauses or expires.

Can I cancel my website builder subscription anytime?
Yes. There are no tied contracts and no cancellation fees. Switch a feature off and it simply will not renew next month; the current month stays active until your renewal date (no refunds for a part-month).

What do I get with the free plan?
Unlimited property listings, List by Voice (add a full listing from photos and a voice note with Instant Listing), AI property search, unlimited staff accounts, a branded MicroSite for your agency, CRM with contacts and leads management, calendar events, lead pipeline, document upload, WhatsApp Community access, and social distribution to Facebook - all free.

How do the CRM pipelines work?
PropertyList includes six CRM pipelines. Lead, Seller and Property are free. Buyer costs 1 credit for each qualified lead you decide to move into it, and the first 5 are free. After that the credits come from your credit balance. Tenants is part of the Rentals Module (Tenants pipeline, Tenancies and Maintenance): 50 credits per 30-day period, with a free 30-day trial and no charge until you renew. Nurture is part of Automation & Nurture, which is free and also includes the automated emails, Hot-lead detection and the Daily Action Queue. New leads land in New Lead and new listings land in Active Listing. Lead and Seller are fixed boards; Buyer and Property you can edit. The legal phase sits inside the Buyer and Property pipelines: Reservation Paid, Deposit Paid, Mortgage in Progress, Notary Appointment and WON - Deed Signed.

How much does the Website Builder cost?
The base site is 50 credits a month and includes your results page, property pages and your first few pages; extra pages are 10 credits/mo each. Add optional power-ups: Instant Content (30 credits/mo, unlimited AI blogs and area guides), AI SEO meta (5 credits/mo), popup lead capture (8 credits/mo), custom domain (20 credits/mo), or remove PropertyList branding (50 credits/mo). Free hosting, SSL, and automatic MLS listing loading are always included.

Can Instant Content run automatically?
Yes. Switch on auto-publish and it writes and publishes unlimited SEO blog posts and area guides for your site by itself, grounded in your own listings and verified market data - or choose review-first and approve each piece before it goes live.

Is there a free trial for paid features?
Yes. Every paid feature comes with a free test, so you can try it before spending any credits: your first 5 buyer leads are free, the property market report gives you 3 free reports, the Rentals Module has a 30-day trial, and the Website Builder is free to build and preview until you publish it live. Verified Agencies also receive 20 free credits, and you earn another 20 credits for every agency that signs up through your referral link, while the new agency starts with 10. Get your referral link ->

## Website Builder
Does PropertyList have a website builder for estate agents?
Yes. PropertyList offers a drag-and-drop website builder designed for estate agents and agencies. Build and preview your full agency site for free, only paying when you publish. See how it works. Do I need to manually upload my properties to my agency website?
No. Every listing in your PropertyList MLS - photos, prices, descriptions - loads onto your agency website automatically. No manual re-entry needed. Can I use my own domain with the PropertyList website builder?
Yes. Connect your own domain (your-agency.com) to your PropertyList website. The custom domain add-on costs 20 credits/month on top of the base plan. What SEO features are included in the PropertyList website builder?
AI-generated SEO meta titles and descriptions for every page, auto-generated location and area pages, and built-in schema markup. Every listing page is structured for search engines out of the box. How do leads from my agency website get into my CRM?
Lead capture forms are embedded on your site and feed enquiries directly into your PropertyList CRM the moment a visitor submits one - no manual export, no lag. What happens to my website if I cancel the website builder subscription?
Your published website goes offline. Your property listings and CRM data are unaffected - everything stays in PropertyList. You can republish at any time with no penalty or re-upload.

## XML Feeds
I already have a website - can I still get my PropertyList properties on it?
Yes, two ways: a live XML feed your site reads on a schedule, or the Website API, a REST key your site calls directly for live results. Your own listings are free to export either way. Powering your site with the whole network is 35 credits a month, XML or API, same price. Both can push to third-party portals at the same time. API docs. What types of properties are included in the XML feed?
The combined feed covers all resale properties, long-term rentals, and holiday rentals in one stream. One feed, all inventory types. Is there a separate XML feed for new developments?
Yes. New development and off-plan properties are in a separate dedicated feed - keeping your resale/rental feed clean and uncluttered. Can I use the XML feed to push listings to other portals like Idealista?
Yes, and pushing to third-party portals is free - Idealista, Fotocasa, or any platform that accepts XML. The feed subscription only applies when you use it to power your own website with the network listings; your own listings are free there too. How much does the XML feed cost?
Pushing your listings to other portals - Idealista, Fotocasa, or any platform that accepts XML - is free. The paid feed is for powering your own website with the listings of the whole network (your own stock is free): 35 credits a month for the resale and rentals feed, and 25 credits/month for the new developments feed. Full pricing.

## Market Intelligence
Does PropertyList offer property market reports?
Yes. The PropertyList Market Intelligence platform (intelligence.propertylist.es) provides data-driven reports across the Costa del Sol, built on live MLS transaction data. Are the market reports free?
Free city snapshots are available without signup - monthly readings covering median price, year-on-year change, and days on market for Marbella, Estepona, Mijas, Benahavís, Fuengirola, Sotogrande, and more. Paid forensic reports and live subscriptions are also available. What are the paid forensic intelligence reports and how much do they cost?
Single-fee PDF reports delivered in under a minute. Pricing: Executive Overview €5, Market Value Index €9, District Deep-Dive €9, New Dev Pipeline €19, Buyer Origin & Demand €19, Investment Forensic €29. Is there a live market dashboard for serious investors or advisors?
Yes. Strategic Investor (€29/month) gives you 5 curated sectors, 10 deep-dive reports per month, weekly data refreshes, and threshold alerts. Enterprise Authority (€99/month) adds unlimited areas, unlimited reports, white-label client PDFs, and advanced buyer-origin heatmaps.

## CRM & Pipelines
Is the PropertyList CRM really free?
The core MLS and CRM are free forever. That includes the Lead, Seller and Property pipelines, with no limits. You pay only for demand: 1 credit for each qualified lead you decide to move into the Buyer pipeline, taken from your credit balance. The Tenants pipeline comes with the Rentals Module subscription and the Nurture pipeline with Automation and Nurture, which is free. See full pricing. What pipeline boards does the PropertyList CRM include?
Six pipelines that work together automatically: Lead (every new lead lands in New Lead), Buyer (qualified purchasers), Seller (vendor journey), Property (stock status, new listings auto-land in Active Listing), Tenants (rental pipeline, part of the Rentals Module subscription) and Nurture (past clients and referrals, part of Automation and Nurture, which is free). The Buyer and Property pipelines also carry the legal phase: Reservation Paid, Deposit Paid, Mortgage in Progress, Notary Appointment and WON - Deed Signed. Lead and Seller are fixed; Buyer and Property are editable. Do I have to set up the pipeline boards manually?
No. All boards are automatically configured and all existing contacts and properties are backfilled onto the correct boards on day one - nothing to set up. How does the pipeline pricing work - what do I actually pay for?
You pay for demand, not for supply. The Lead, Seller and Property pipelines are free. The Buyer pipeline costs 1 credit for each qualified lead you decide to move into it, and buyer credits come from your credit balance. The Tenants pipeline comes with the Rentals Module: 50 credits per 30-day period, with a free 30-day trial. The Nurture pipeline comes with Automation and Nurture, which is free and also covers all automated emails, Hot-lead detection and the Daily Action Queue. Can I keep a listing private and not share it with other agents?
Yes. On My Listings, select any properties and use Bulk actions > "Do not share with other agents". The property is hidden from other agencies in the MLS, kept off their microsites and removed from all export feeds - but stays live on the public portal, so direct buyers still find it and every lead comes to you. Your first 5 live private listings are free, then 5 credits each, and you can re-enable sharing any time. Read the guide. Can I connect my own email (Gmail or Outlook) to the CRM?
Coming soon. You will open Settings, then Connected inbox, in the CRM and connect Gmail/Google Workspace or Outlook/Microsoft 365 with a secure OAuth sign-in on their own page, so no password reaches PropertyList. Client replies then appear on the matching contact, and mail you write in the CRM goes out through your own account, so the client sees your address rather than a platform address. It costs 10 Credits per connected mailbox per month, and disconnecting stops the charge. See how it works or read the setup guide.

## Rentals Module
Does PropertyList have a rentals management module?
Yes. The Rentals Module unlocks the full rental workflow - from first enquiry through to lease completion and renewal. Does the Rentals module handle deposit disputes and keep me compliant with Spanish rental law?
It gives you the evidence, not the compliance. The audit log timestamps every status and deposit change with the agent responsible - which is what a deposit dispute under LAU art. 36 turns on. It does not lodge deposits with a regional body or file any registration for you.

## Credits & Pricing
How do PropertyList credits work?
1 credit. Buy in bulk for a discount. Credits never expire. Used to unlock paid features across the platform. For anything monthly, you can switch on auto top-up: a saved card refills your balance by the cost of your active subscriptions the day before renewal, so nothing pauses. It is a way to pay, not an extra charge. See credit pricing. Do credits expire?
No. PropertyList credits never expire - use them at your own pace. Can I earn free credits on PropertyList?
Yes. Get your agency verified (free, and any time you like) and receive 20 free credits. Agents also earn 20 credits for each agency that signs up via their referral link - and the new signup gets 10 credits.

## MCP & Developers
Does PropertyList have an API for developers?
Two, for different jobs. The Website API pulls your own PropertyList stock into your website (a REST key you create, rotate and revoke in your account, 35 credits a month for the whole network, free for your own listings). The MCP at propertylist.es/mcp is a Model Context Protocol server for Spanish and Portuguese property data: AI agents can search the market (search_properties, find_properties_by_description, autocomplete_location, get_property, area_market_summary, list_agencies), send a qualified enquiry straight to a listing agency (submit_enquiry), and, with a free agency key, work your own CRM: listings, leads, pipeline, contacts and notes. Website API docs, MCP. Can I connect PropertyList to AI tools like Claude, Cursor, or Perplexity?
Yes. The MCP connects live PropertyList data to any MCP-compatible client - Claude, Cursor, Zed, Perplexity and any Model Context Protocol tool - so an AI agent can search your market on your behalf. Install via Claude Desktop config, npx adapter or the direct JSON-RPC endpoint. Structured search works with no key; the natural-language AI matcher and your CRM tools need an agency key, and the key is issued automatically: click Connect in Claude or ChatGPT and sign in with your PropertyList account. Is the MCP free to use?
Four tiers. Public: free, no signup, no key, structured search, location autocomplete, full listing detail and area market summaries at 60 requests a minute. Agent: a free key issued automatically when you sign in with your PropertyList account, which switches on the natural-language AI matcher and your own CRM tools (listings, leads, pipeline, contacts and notes), with 200 AI searches a month included, then 1 credit per 10 searches from your agency wallet, at 600 requests a minute. Pro: 50 credits a month from your credit wallet, which lifts the volume limits; upgrade self-serve in the CRM under Settings and drop back to the free key any time. Enterprise: custom, billed by contract, for banks, valuers, portals and AI product teams. propertylist.es/mcp.

## Oracle
What is PropertyList Oracle?
PropertyList Oracle (oracle.propertylist.es) is a live, signed €/m² price feed for Spanish real estate - purpose-built for tokenisation platforms, on-chain lenders, and property-backed stablecoin issuers who need daily attestation. Built for RWA (Real World Asset) protocols. Explore PropertyList Oracle.

## What is PropertyList and how does it work?
5 questions
What is PropertyList?

PropertyList is the system Spanish estate agencies run on: one login that replaces the CRM, the MLS, the portal presence, the agency website, the AI marketing tools and the market-data subscriptions an agency would otherwise buy from four or five vendors. List a property once and every agent on the shared network can sell it with you, while buyers find it on propertylist.es.
The AI does the heavy lifting: a listing written from photos and a voice note, buyers matched against the whole market from a pasted client message, and follow-up that keeps working your database - grounded in notary-verified sale prices, not asking-price guesses.
The core is free with no listing limit; paid extras run on prepaid credits. Full comparison with the traditional portals: what is the best MLS, CRM and property portal in Spain? Is PropertyList.es really free to use?

The core is free with no limit for estate agents, agencies and developers: the MLS, unlimited listings, team accounts and the Lead, Seller and Property pipelines, with no setup costs and no lock-in contracts.
It is not 100% free: moving a qualified buyer lead into the Buyer pipeline costs 1 credit, and your first 5 are free. Up to that decision the lead costs nothing, and if you never move it, you are never charged.
Other paid features - featured listings, AI tools, CMA reports and enhanced visibility - are pay-as-you-go from the same credit balance. You only pay for services that directly help you close deals. What is the difference between PropertyList and traditional property portals like Idealista or Fotocasa?

Traditional portals charge upfront listing fees or subscriptions regardless of results. PropertyList operates on a results-driven model:

-
For Agents: Upload unlimited staff and direct listings + CRM tools to collaborate and manage leads
-
For Developers: Free listings with commission-only payment when units sell
-
For Buyers: Free access to all properties with no paywalls
-
AI Integration: Contextual AI presents property services only when relevant to active transactions
Unlike Idealista, Resales-Online, or Inmobalia, we treat the MLS as a public utility - free access for verified real estate professionals. What is an MLS and why do I need one?

An MLS (Multiple Listing Service) is a platform where real estate agents share property information and collaborate on listings. PropertyList.es facilitates agent-to-agent communication, allowing you to expose your listings to a wider pool of potential buyers represented by other agents - totally free.
This cooperation increases your inventory exposure and accelerates sales without additional marketing costs. Who can join PropertyList.es?

We welcome:

-
Freelance agents (cost-efficient listing sharing)
-
Estate agencies (staff management, document handling, team coordination)
-
Property developers (reach agents and buyers, free new development listings)
-
Property service providers (lawyers, architects, mortgage brokers - connect with agents and developers at transaction moments)
-
International agents (our recent upgrade lets agents based outside Spain list and join too)

Yes. You can add unlimited staff members, assign contacts to agents, track team activity and communications, manage permissions and roles, and coordinate viewing schedules and follow-ups. How do I list a property on PropertyList.es?

You must be a registered agent with a verified PropertyList.es account. Once approved, you can add properties manually or import them via XML feed for free. Each listing can include detailed descriptions, images, virtual tours, and amenity filters to attract qualified buyers.

## What do I need to know about buying property in Spain?
6 questions
Is now a good time to invest in Marbella real estate?

Yes. Marbella’s property market shows strong fundamentals:

-
Price Growth: 10-12% annual increase (2024 data)
-
Average Price: €4,228-€4,509/m² (verified transaction prices, not asking prices)
-
Market Resilience: Luxury segment (€2M+) remains strong with <10% requiring financing
-
Foreign Demand: 33%+ of buyers in Málaga province are international
-
Golden Mile Premium: Up to €611 per square foot in prime areas What are the hottest areas for property investment in Marbella right now?

Based on 2024-2025 transaction data:

-
Nagüeles-Golden Mile: €611/sq ft
-
Nueva Andalucía: €510/sq ft
-
Marbella East (Las Chapas-El Rosario): €456/sq ft
-
Elviria-Cabopino: €344/sq ft
-
Fastest Growing: Los Flamingos, El Paraíso, El Real de La Quinta Do I need a Spanish bank account to buy property in Spain?

While not legally required, having a Spanish bank account is highly recommended for paying utilities and community fees, setting up direct debits for IBI (property tax), transferring funds for purchase completion, and receiving rental income if investing. What is the NIE and do I need it to buy property in Spain?

The NIE (Número de Identificación de Extranjero) is Spain’s foreign identification number. Yes, it is mandatory for any property transaction, opening a bank account, or signing contracts.
Apply at Spanish consulates in your home country or local police stations in Spain. Processing typically takes 2-4 weeks. What are the main taxes when buying property in Spain?

-
New Properties: 10% VAT (IVA) + 1.5% stamp duty (AJD)
-
Resale Properties: 7% transfer tax (ITP) in Andalucía
-
Annual IBI: Property tax based on cadastral value (0.4-1.1%)
-
Capital Gains: 19-24% on profit when selling (non-residents)
-
Plusvalía: Municipal tax on land value increase What is Spain's Golden Visa program?

The Golden Visa offers residency to non‑EU investors who invest €500,000+ in Spanish real estate, maintain the investment for 5+ years, and renew residency every 2 years.
Benefits: Freedom to travel the Schengen zone, family inclusion, and a path to permanent residency. Note: the program can change - confirm current regulations.

Questions

## What agents ask first.

Is it really free to build?
Yes. Building and previewing cost nothing. You are charged only when you publish: 50 credits a month, plus any add-ons you switch on.
What happens when I publish?
Your site goes live with your listings and whatever network stock you chose to show. From then you pay 50 credits a month, plus any add-ons you switched on.
Can I change template later?
Yes. Switch to any of the fifteen whenever you want, and keep your words, pages and settings.
Do I have to upload my listings?
No. Your listings and the network stock are already there, and update when a listing changes in the CRM. Nothing is typed twice.
Where do enquiries go?
Into your PropertyList CRM, with an email for each one. Lead, Seller and Property pipelines are free with no limit; moving one into Buyer costs 1 credit.
Can I use my own domain?
Yes, for 20 credits a month. Until then your site runs at your-agency-name.estate-agency.co, so your name is in the address, not ours.
What if I cancel?
Your site reverts to the free agency microsite at the end of the billing period. You keep your domain.
Is the SEO any good?
Clean structure, titles and descriptions on every page from day one. Auto SEO and GEO (5 credits a month) rechecks your site weekly and updates the keywords to what buyers search for now. No platform can honestly promise rankings.
Do I need to be technical?
No. Pick a template, edit it in an editor showing the real site, publish when you are ready. Or describe the change in plain English and let the AI do it.
Who hosts it, and is it secure?
We do. Hosting and Cloudflare protection are included: fast, shielded from attacks, nothing for you to manage or renew.
Are the legal pages included?
Yes. Aviso legal, privacy and cookies pages, plus a cookie banner, come with every template and are never billed separately.

## Questions, answered

Can I use it if I am not an estate agent?
Yes. Anyone can create a professional brochure for a property at propertylist.es/brochures for 20 euros each - ideal if you are selling privately and want your home to look like an agency listed it. Estate agents get it free, built into their platform. Why is it free for agents?
Agents are platform members, and brochures are one of the free tools inside their dashboard. The 20 euro price is the one-off, no-membership option for everyone else. Which properties can have a brochure?
Any property on the MLS or the public portal - sale or rental, resale or new development. If it has photos and details, it can become a brochure in seconds. What do I actually choose?
A theme, whether it is branded or unbranded, and the language. Everything else - photos, price, features, map, energy label - is filled in automatically. You review it before you share it. Does it include the energy rating?
Yes, and this matters: Spanish law requires the energy efficiency rating (A to G) in any property advertising, including brochures, and leaving it out can mean a fine of 300 to 6,000 euros. Instant Brochure builds the label straight in, so your brochures stay on the right side of the law without you thinking about it. What is the unbranded version for?
Sharing a property with another agent on the MLS without your branding on the sheet they show their client, or as a clean white-label document. Branded is for your own client-facing marketing. Can I share it as a link instead of a PDF?
Yes - every brochure comes as both. The print-ready PDF is there for windows, viewings and anything you want on paper; the live web link opens beautifully on a phone or laptop, so it is ideal for WhatsApp, email and social. One click, both formats, no extra cost. Does the shared link stay up to date, and can I see who opens it?
Yes to both. The live web version reflects the listing on the portal, so if the price changes or the property goes under offer, the link a buyer already has updates itself - no need to resend anything. You can also see when it has been opened and how often, and its enquiry button sends any new interest straight into your CRM pipeline. The PDF, by contrast, is a fixed snapshot from the moment you export it. Can I print it and share it?
Yes. The print-ready PDF is made for window displays and viewings, while the live link is made for digital sharing. Each branded brochure carries a QR code back to your live listing.

One size 2 credits, all 3 sizes 4 credits. Market infographic 3 credits.

## Launching very soon. Be first in line.

Leave your email and we will send one message the day Instant Images goes live - nothing else. And if you are not on PropertyList yet, set up your free account now so you are ready on day one. Notify me at launch

Create your free account

## Questions, answered

Will buyers know the photos are edited?
Where it matters, yes - on purpose. Virtually staged rooms and materially edited images carry a clear label, which protects you legally and builds trust. Light and colour improvements like twilight or a blue sky are standard practice in property marketing and do not change what the property is. What will it refuse to do?
Anything that would misrepresent the property: it will not remove or hide permanent features and defects - damp, cracks, power lines, a road outside. It improves light, sky, gardens and presentation, and stages furniture. That line is what keeps your listings safe. Does it replace my original photos?
Never. Enhanced photos are saved alongside your originals as extra versions you can choose from, and you can revert in one click. Your original photos always stay on the listing record. My imported photos are small and blurry - can it fix them?
Yes. The upscaler raises small, compressed photos (common on feed-imported listings) to sharp portal quality. It is one credit per photo like any other enhancement. What does it cost?
Planned pricing is pay-as-you-go with your PropertyList credits: 1 credit per enhanced photo, 10 credits for a whole listing, 5 credits per staged room, and social cards from 2 credits. 1 credit, no subscription. Final pricing is confirmed at launch. When can I use it?
Very soon - it ships alongside Instant Video in the new Marketing section. Join the waitlist below and we will send one email the day it goes live. Not on PropertyList yet? Your free account takes minutes to set up.

# AI Property Search
URL: https://info.propertylist.es/ai-property-search/

Live on the portal · Beta for agents

# Stop translating wishes into filters.
Just say what you want.

"2-bed apartment in Estepona near the beach, under €400k." That sentence is a finished search. PropertyList's
AI reads plain words - yours or your client's - and brings back the right homes from real, live listings. No
dropdowns, no checkboxes, no lost buyers.

Try it on the portal - free For agents: match your clients

## For buyers and renters: search the whole portal by describing your home

On propertylist.es, type what you are looking
for the way you would tell a friend. The AI reads your brief and finds the closest matches across every live
listing on the portal - free, no account needed.

The search box on the portal - describe your ideal home in plain words.
The AI shows what it understood - 2 bedrooms · Apartment · Estepona · Under €400k · Near the beach - then the closest live matches.
You always see what the AI understood, shown as chips above the results. Refine your sentence and search again - it is a conversation, not a form.

## For agents: AI Property Match BETA

Your client sends a WhatsApp: "3-bed near an international school, budget around €1.2M but flexible if
there's a sea view." Paste it into AI Property Match in your dashboard, and it searches
your own stock first, then the whole MLS network - and ranks the best matches before another agent has
finished setting filters. If you don't have the perfect property, another agency on the network
might, and you can still close the deal.

AI Property Match in the agent dashboard - describe your client in plain English.
It sets up the search, sticks to the budget, and ranks your own listings as the primary matches.

- Paste, don't re-type. The client's own words are the input - a forwarded message is enough.
- Your stock first, network second. Your own listings lead the ranking ("Primary search"), with matches from the whole shared MLS behind them - so there is always something to show.
- Transparent. The chips show exactly what it understood, so you can correct course instantly.
- Free in beta. Included with the free MLS while AI Property Match is in beta.
Open your dashboard No account? Join free

## Why this beats filter search

- Nothing gets lost in translation. "Near the beach" and "flexible if sea view" are real search criteria here - filters can't say that.
- Faster to the right homes. One sentence replaces a dozen clicks, on any device.
- Real listings only. The AI never invents a property - it understands your words, then searches live stock.

## Common questions

How does AI property search work?
You type what you want in plain words - like "2-bed apartment in Estepona near the beach, under €400k". The AI reads your brief, turns it into a structured search (bedrooms, type, area, budget, must-haves) and shows the closest live matches. You can see exactly what it understood as filter chips. Is the AI search free?
Yes. AI property search on the propertylist.es portal is free for everyone - no account needed. AI Property Match for agents is included in the free MLS while in beta. What is AI Property Match for agents?
It is the same idea pointed at your inventory: paste your client’s request - even a forwarded WhatsApp message - and it searches your own stock first, then the whole MLS network of shared properties, ranking the best matches and showing what it understood as chips. It lives in your agent dashboard and is in beta. Does the AI invent properties?
No. It only searches real, live listings. The AI’s job is understanding your words - the results are always actual properties on the portal or in your MLS stock, each with its reference number.

## Your next client already wrote the search.

Try it with a real brief - yours, or the last one a client sent you.
Search the portal with AI Match your clients (agents)

## An asking price is an opinion.
The register is a fact.

Every number on that drive comes from two places. The asking prices are live listings on PropertyList,
updated as agents post them. The verified €/m&sup2; comes from the Spanish notarial register through the
PropertyList Oracle - the prices
buyers and sellers actually signed for.

They are two different populations, not a discount: asking prices describe what is on the market today, the
register describes completed sales across all property types. Read together they tell you where a town s
expectations sit against its reality - which is exactly the conversation a good agent has with a seller.

The coast runs out here

## Common questions

Is it really free, or is it a trial?
Free forever, not a trial. The MLS, the CRM core, your portal presence, your MicroSite and the tools above cost nothing and always will. There is no card required to start and no monthly fee on the core. What is paid is separate and optional: 1 credit for each qualified lead you choose to move into the Buyer pipeline, and the monthly Rentals Module. Automation & Nurture is free. Then how does PropertyList make money?
Two ways. Credits, for demand and one-offs: 1 credit for each qualified lead you decide to move into your Buyer pipeline, taken from your credit balance, plus featuring a listing to the top, notary-verified valuation reports, a full custom website builder, or keeping a sale off the shared network. And a monthly subscription for the Rentals Module, which runs in the background: 50 credits per 30 days, with a free 30-day trial. Your listings and your sellers stay free, so you pay for demand and never for supply. The core stays free because a bigger, shared network is worth more to everyone on it. What is the catch?
There is not one on price. The trade is that your listings are shared with other agents on the network - that is the point, it is how you get more people able to sell your stock. If you ever need a listing kept private, you can (first 5 free, then 5 credits each). Do I have to leave my current portal or CRM?
No. Import your existing XML feed, keep whatever else you use, and run PropertyList alongside it for free. Most agents find they stop paying for the extras once they see what is included. How many agents are actually on it?
More than 1,390+ agents across 1,000+ agencies, mostly on the Costa del Sol, with 6,130+ live listings in the shared pool. Real, registered local agencies - not bots or ghost accounts.

# Referral Program
URL: https://info.propertylist.es/referrals/

Referral Program

# Refer an agency. You get 20 credits, they get 10.

Every estate agent on PropertyList has a unique referral link. Share it, and for every agency that signs up and is
approved you earn 20 credits to spend on paid features - and the agency you referred starts with 10. Unlimited
referrals, and the core MLS and CRM stay free forever.

Get your referral link See pricing
1 credit. Credits never expire.

## How it works

Three steps, and the crediting is automatic. Share your link once and let every approved signup pay you back.

1

### Share your link

Every PropertyList account has a unique referral link. Copy it from your referrals dashboard and share it with any agency - by WhatsApp, email or social.

2

### They sign up and get approved

The agency joins PropertyList through your link and is approved as a Verified Agency - free forever, like every agent on the network.

3

### You both get credits, automatically

On approval, 20 credits land in your account and 10 in theirs. No forms, no chasing - every signup is tracked and paid out for you.

## What you earn

For every agency you refer, you get 20 credits - ~20€ - and they start with 10 credits, ~10€.
Credits are added automatically the moment the agency is approved.

20 credits for you 10 credits for them Unlimited referrals

## No cap, no catch

There is no limit on how many agencies you can refer or how many credits you can earn, and credits never expire.
Spend them on any paid feature - featured listings, Property Specific Market Analysis, XML export, Website Builder
add-ons and more.

Referring peers also grows the agent-to-agent network you sell into: every agency that joins adds their listings and
their buyers to the shared MLS.

## What your credits get you

1 credit, and credits work on any paid feature. Here is what a few referrals add up to.

20 credits

### 1 referral

Feature one of your listings for a full week - the most popular 7-day boost - or run 4 Property Specific Market Analyses.

40 credits

### 2 referrals

Feature a listing for 15 days at the best-value rate, or give two separate listings a full week each.

60 credits / month

### 3 referrals a month

Enough to cover a Website Builder site (from 50 credits/mo, about €50) with automatic SEO - your own branded agency website,
effectively paid for by referrals.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I get my referral link?

Log in to PropertyList and open the referrals section of your dashboard. Your unique link is there, ready to copy and share. Everything after that - tracking signups and paying out credits - happens automatically.

### How many credits do I earn?

20 credits for every agency that signs up through your link and is approved, with no limit. The agency you refer also starts with 10 credits.

### When are the credits added?

As soon as the agency you referred is approved on PropertyList. The 20 credits go to you and 10 to them, added to each account automatically.

### Is there a limit on how many agencies I can refer?

No. Refer 5 agencies or 50 - you earn 20 credits for every single one that is approved. Credits never expire.

### What can I spend referral credits on?

Any paid feature. 1 credit, use them for featured listings, Property Specific Market Analysis, XML export, Website Builder add-ons and more.

## Turn your network into credits

Grab your unique link and share it with the agencies you know. Every approved signup is 20 credits in your account -
and 10 in theirs.

Get your referral link See all features

# Rentals Module
URL: https://info.propertylist.es/rentals/

Rentals Module

# Your rental book, out of the spreadsheet.

The Rentals Module runs long-term lettings inside the CRM you already use for sales: a tenants pipeline, one record per tenancy that
chases its own renewals and deposit deadlines, and repairs the tenant starts and the landlord approves. Import the book you already
manage by CSV. Free for 30 days, no card, and nothing is charged when the trial ends.

Start the free trial
What it costs
Already with PropertyList? Open the Rentals tab in your account. No credit card required.

An illustration of the tenancy record, not a recording of the CRM. The property is a real long-term let on
the PropertyList MLS, and the dates are the real ones: the IRAV update, the four-month notice window under
LAU art. 10, and the one month to return the fianza under art. 36.
Long-term lettings Live today. Free 30-day trial. Holiday and short lets Coming soon. The rules that already apply, and the waitlist.

## Start with the tenancies you already manage

Three ways in, and none of them is typing it all again.

### Import CSV

A button at the top of the Tenancies screen, not a buried setting. Bring a whole rental book over in one go.

### From the deal

A rental deal that reaches Contract Signed writes its own tenancy: property, tenant, landlord, dates, rent and deposit. You fill the gaps.

### By hand

New Tenancy, for the agreements that live nowhere else yet.

Nothing changes on the sales side. Same login, same contacts, same listings, same sales pipeline. The module
adds a Rentals section with Tenancies and Maintenance, and the Tenants board.

## From enquiry to signed lease

The Tenants pipeline, exactly as it ships. Thirteen stages, and two of them do work for you.
1Rental Lead-> 2Qualified, criteria defined-> 3Matching properties-> 4Viewings booked-> 5Viewings in progress-> 6Negotiating-> 7Reservation paid-> 8Contract review-> 9Contract signed-> 10Deposit paid-> 11Awaiting move-in-> 12Active tenancy-> 13Renewal pending
9 At Contract signed the tenancy writes itself from the deal, and your listing is set to reserved. If the property belongs to
another agency, they get an email asking them to update it, because PropertyList does not change another agency's listing. A lettings
tool with no other agencies in it cannot do this at any price.

12 At Active tenancy you are asked for the dates, the tenant and landlord details and marketing consent, and both go into Nurture.

## What is inside

Nine things the module does, most of them without being asked. All of it is long-term lettings.

### Tenants pipeline

Thirteen stages from first enquiry to active tenancy, on its own board, beside the sales pipeline you already run.

### Tenancies that keep themselves current

One record per lease. Draft, then Active when the start date passes, then Expiring when the renewal window opens. You do not move it.

### Your existing book, imported

CSV import for a whole rental book, a manual option for one-offs, and new deals create their own tenancy.

### Renewal alerts

The tenancy moves to Renewal Pending and tells you before the lease ends, on a window you set at 60, 90 or 120 days.

### Annual rent review

It knows the anniversary and the current rent, works out the permitted new rent against the official index, and drafts the notice.

### Deposit tracking and audit log

Unpaid, Held, then Returned or partly withheld, every change timestamped against the agent responsible, with the lodging window watched where your region still requires it.

### Repairs the tenant starts

Tenants raise their own tickets by magic link with photos, no login, already attached to their tenancy. You triage rather than transcribe.

### Landlord approval thresholds

Small jobs go ahead. Anything above the threshold goes to the landlord with photos and quote, and they approve or decline in one click.

### Rentals dashboard

Live tenancies, expiring in 60 days, monthly rent roll, your monthly income as management commission at the rate set per tenancy, deposits and actions needed, plus your average days to resolve.

## What the tenancy does while you get on with selling

One record per lease, and its status follows the dates rather than waiting for someone to remember.

### The tenancy

Created from the deal, imported from your spreadsheet by CSV, or added by hand for the contracts you already manage.

#### Renewals

Moves to Renewal Pending before the lease ends and tells you, on a window you set at 60, 90 or 120 days.

#### Annual rent review

Knows the anniversary and the current rent, works out the permitted new rent against the official index, and drafts the notice to the tenant.

#### Deposit compliance

Unpaid, Held, then Returned or partly withheld, every change timestamped. Where your region still requires lodging, it records that and chases it.

#### Notice deadlines

You are warned before the deadline passes, not after.

#### Repair history

Every maintenance ticket hangs off the tenancy, so a property's whole history sits in one place.
Draft-> Active-> Expiring-> RenewedorPeriodicorEnded A renewal chains to a new linked tenancy, so the history stays intact.

## A repair, from the tenant's phone to closed

The part that eats a letting agent's week. Three parties, one thread.

Tenant

- Opens the magic link sent at move-in and repeated in their emails. No login, no app.
- Describes the problem and adds photos. A plumber quoting from two photos often saves a visit.
- Confirms the repair at the end, which is what closes the ticket.
You

- The ticket arrives already linked to the tenancy, tenant and property. You triage it.
- Send it to a supplier from the directory, with description, photos and address filled in. Response times and cost history build up per supplier.
- Record who pays: landlord, tenant, agency or split.

Urgent jobs, a leak or no water or anything electrical, go straight to the Daily Action Queue with an SLA timer. Anything sitting a
week without an update surfaces like a stalled deal. The annual boiler revision and gas certificate raise their own ticket on the
anniversary.

Landlord

- Nothing at all, if the cost is under the approval threshold you hold for them.
- Above it, an email with the issue, the photos and the quote.
- Approve or Decline in one click, and the decision is on the record if it is ever disputed.

## Six numbers, one screen

The rentals dashboard, so you can answer a landlord without opening a spreadsheet.

Live tenancies
Expiring in 60 days
Monthly rent roll
Your monthly income
Deposits
Actions needed
Your monthly income is your management commission, at the rate set on each tenancy, so the rent roll and what it actually pays you sit side by side. Plus your average days to resolve a repair, and views for live, expiring, ended and all.

## Built for Spanish rental law

The audit log timestamps every status and deposit change against the agent responsible, giving you defensible evidence for deposit
disputes under LAU art. 36 and the deposit rules of your region.

No more reconstructing who changed what, and when, after a dispute has already started.

Two deadlines the module records but does not decide for you. To stop a contract renewing, LAU art. 10 gives the landlord four months
and the tenant two. And since 24 January 2026 an Andalusian landlord no longer lodges the fianza with AVRA (Ley 5/2025, DA 6 ) -
it stays with the landlord. Lodging still applies in Catalonia, Madrid and Valencia, and deposits lodged before that date are still
returned through the old process.
The rules in full.

## What it costs

The first 30 days are free and no card is needed. Nothing is charged when the trial ends. If you want to keep it you subscribe, and
from then it is 50 credits per 30-day period taken from your prepaid credit balance. Switch on auto top-up and a saved card refills the
balance rather than the module pausing. Stop the subscription whenever you want.

If you stop, nothing is deleted. The module is hidden until you subscribe again, and your tenancies, deposits and repair history are
exactly where you left them when it comes back.
30 days free No card to start 50 credits / 30 days Stop any time

## What it does not do

Worth knowing before you start the trial rather than during it.

### Not in the module

- It does not lodge your deposits. Where your region still requires lodging, the tenancy records it and warns you before the window closes. Filing it stays yours.
- It does not file with the police or issue registration numbers. A long-term tenancy never triggers police registration at all, because a tenant is not a traveller. For holiday bookings, automatic guest registration is coming. See guest registration with the police for the duty itself.
- Seasonal contracts. The module is built around long-term lettings, and the annual rent review in particular assumes a long-term rent. Talk to us before you move a temporada book across.

### On the roadmap

- Holiday and short lets. Bookings, nightly rates, channel sync and guest registration will come later. If your book is holiday rather than long-term, see what is being built and add your name.
- Landlord statements. A periodic report per landlord covering repairs done, what they cost, the invoices, deposit status and rent roll. Every ticket already records who pays, so the data will be there when it ships.

## Questions

Can I bring the tenancies I already manage into it?
Yes. Import CSV sits at the top of the Tenancies screen and brings an existing rental book over in one go. There is a manual option for one-off agreements, and any new rental deal creates its tenancy automatically when it reaches Contract Signed, pre-filled from the deal. What does the Rentals module include?
A Tenants pipeline of thirteen stages, tenancies that move through Draft, Active, Expiring and then Renewed, Periodic or Ended on their own, renewal alerts on a window you set, the annual rent review against the official index, deposit tracking with an audit log, maintenance tickets the tenant raises by magic link with landlord approval thresholds and a supplier directory, and a dashboard of live tenancies, expiring contracts, rent roll, your monthly income, deposits and actions needed. It covers long-term lettings. How much does the Rentals module cost, and what happens after the trial?
The first 30 days are free and no card is needed. Nothing is charged when the trial ends. If you want to keep it you subscribe, and from then it is 50 credits per 30-day period taken from your prepaid credit balance. You can switch on auto top-up so a saved card refills the balance instead of the module pausing, and you can stop the subscription whenever you want. What happens to my tenancies if I stop paying for the module?
Nothing is deleted. The module is hidden until you subscribe again, and your tenancies, deposits and repair history are exactly where you left them when it comes back. Does it change anything on the sales side of my agency?
No. Same login, same contacts, same listings, same sales pipeline. The module adds a Rentals section with Tenancies and Maintenance, and the Tenants pipeline board. Do tenants and landlords need accounts?
No. Tenants report repairs through a magic link sent at move-in and repeated in their emails, with photos and no login. Landlords approve or decline a job above their threshold from an email, in one click. Does the Rentals module keep me compliant with Spanish rental law?
It gives you the evidence, not the compliance. The audit log timestamps every status and deposit change with the agent responsible, which is what a deposit dispute under LAU art. 36 turns on. It does not lodge deposits with a regional body or issue a rental registration number: those stay your obligation. It files nothing with the police either, and for a long-term tenancy it never will, because a tenant living in the property as their home is not a traveller and the duty does not apply. Automatic guest registration is coming for holiday bookings only. Does it handle holiday lets?
Not today. Bookings, nightly rates, channel sync and guest registration with the police are on the roadmap, and the holiday page sets out what is coming and takes your name for it. If your book is holiday rather than long-term, this is not yet the tool for you. Seasonal contracts sit in between: talk to us before you move a temporada book across.

## Run lettings the same place you run sales

One login, one contact database, one workflow for the whole agency. Already with PropertyList? The Rentals tab is in your account, with
Tenancies and Maintenance inside it.

# Sales Pipelines
URL: https://info.propertylist.es/pipelines/

The PropertyList CRM

# Most lost deals were never lost to another agency. They were never followed up.

Six pipelines that carry every lead, every listing and every past client forward on their own. Your listings and your sellers stay
free. You choose which of them is worth a credit.

Create your free agency account
See what it costs
1,000+ agencies and 1,390+ agents are already on the network. No card, no setup fee.

## Where the money actually leaks

Not from bad agents. From the ordinary week of a busy one.

### The enquiry that waited an hour

It arrives while you are at a viewing. By the time you reply they have spoken to three other agencies. The first agent to say something useful usually keeps the client.

### The follow-up you did from memory

Day one you call. Day three you mean to. Day seven it is gone. Nobody decides to drop a lead. It happens in the gaps between viewings.

### The client you already closed

They bought through you four years ago. When they sell, they call whoever stayed in touch. Often that is not the agent who sold them the house.

## Six pipelines, one workflow

Each one covers a stage of the job, and contacts move between them as the deal moves. No spreadsheets, nothing typed twice.

The Lead Pipeline as it actually looks. The tabs along the top are the six boards, each labelled with what it costs, and the timer on
each card is how long that lead has been waiting.

### Leads
Free
Every enquiry lands here and gets acknowledged before you have picked up your phone. The stages are fixed, so nothing drifts.

### Buyers
1 credit when you move one in
Finance confirmed, viewings, offer, negotiation, arras, notary, signed deed. Everything up to qualifying is free. The credit is only spent if you decide that contact is worth moving in. Say no and nothing happens: they stay in your contacts, they just do not join the Buyer pipeline.

### Sellers
Free
Valuation booked, valuation done, agreement signed, photos, live on the portal. Free on purpose: listings are the thing we want more of.

### Property
Free
Your stock, from off market through to completed, with days on market on every card and a one-click recovery when a sale falls through.

### Tenants
Rentals Module
The road to a signed contract, then a tenancy that renews itself, reviews its own rent and keeps the deposit compliant.

### Nurture
Automation
Everyone you have already closed, kept in touch with, and handed back to you the moment they show interest in moving again.

## What happens while you are out at a viewing

These are not settings you have to remember to switch on. They are what the pipelines do.

- A lead arrives and is acknowledged straight away by email and WhatsApp, while you get a push notification.
- A follow-up plan is written for you as tasks: day 0, day 1, day 3, day 7, mixing calls, WhatsApp and email.
- You qualify the lead, and it moves itself onto the right pipeline with the client’s property alert already set from what they told you.
- A listing goes quiet, and the board raises a price-review task on whatever interval you set.
- A tenancy approaches its end date, moves to Renewal Pending, and asks the tenant and the landlord the right question at the right time.
- A long-term rent is due its annual review, so the permitted new rent is calculated and the notice to the tenant is drafted.

## The part almost nobody does

Every agency knows it should stay in touch with past clients. Almost none of them do it past the first month, because there is always
a live deal that matters more today.

Nurture keeps them without you. Birthdays, the anniversary of the day they signed, an honest note on what their home is worth now.
When one of them clicks a valuation link or opens the same email three times in a week, the automated emails stop and you get told
to call, with the reason attached.

A lead that goes quiet in March often buys in October, usually from whoever stayed in touch.

## You can watch it before you switch it on

Before you switch it on, the Nurture board still fills up. Every closed deal still lands on it, the details are still collected, and
a counter tells you what the month would have sent.

Nothing goes out until you decide it should. When you switch it on, it starts with everything it has been collecting rather than from
an empty screen.

Free One email per contact per week Off switch per contact

## One screen that answers "what do I do today"

Email is the part that can be automated. Calls and WhatsApp are the parts that close. So the automation sends what it can send, then
tells you the handful of things only you can do, in order of what is most likely to earn.

1

### Hot contacts first

Someone who just clicked a valuation link or opened the same email three times this week, with the reason on the card.

2

### New leads still in time

The ones where a reply in the next few minutes still decides who gets the client.

3

### Deals going stale

A buyer who has sat in Viewings Booked for ten days and needs a nudge today.

4

### The personal ones

It is a past client’s birthday. The email already went. Twenty seconds on WhatsApp is worth more.

The list is capped at around ten actions a day, on purpose. A short queue you finish beats a complete one you learn to ignore. Each card
calls or opens WhatsApp with the message already written, and one tap logs how it went.

## Other agents never cost you a credit

Agents from other agencies enquire on your listings all day, which is the point of a shared network. Every incoming lead is checked against the register of agents on the network,
by email, by phone and by agency domain.

A match is tagged in red, never charged a credit, and left out of every automated email, so a homeowner valuation never lands in a co-broker's inbox.
If we get it wrong, one click removes the tag, and your correction stays on your account rather than following that person around
the network.

## What it costs

- Leads, Sellers and Property pipelines Free, no limit
- Buyer lead 1 credit, only when you move them into the Buyer pipeline
- Rentals Module: Tenants, Tenancies and Maintenance 50 credits / 30 days, free 30-day trial
- Automation and Nurture, including the Daily Action Queue Free
- An enquiry that turns out to be another agent Never charged

One credit balance covers all of it, the same one you use for featuring a listing or pulling a report. Credits you buy do not expire.
See the full price list.

## The questions agents actually ask

What does it actually cost?
The Leads, Sellers and Property pipelines are free with no limit. A buyer lead costs 1 credit, charged only when you choose to move that contact into the Buyer pipeline. Qualifying costs nothing, and an unqualified enquiry never costs anything. The Rentals Module, which runs on its own, is 50 credits per 30 days, free for the first 30 days. Automation and Nurture is free. Everything comes out of the same credit balance you already use for featuring and reports. Do I have to set any of this up?
No. All six pipelines are configured for you, and your existing contacts and properties are placed on the right one from day one. New leads land in New Lead, new listings land in Active Listing. You can edit the stages on Buyers and Property. Leads and Sellers are fixed so the reporting stays comparable across agencies. Will it email my clients without me knowing?
It will send, and you will always be able to see exactly what. Every contact has a timeline showing what has gone out and what is scheduled next, and you can view, edit or skip any of it. Marketing consent is recorded per contact, unsubscribes are honoured, and no contact receives more than one email a week however many sequences they are in. You can also switch nurture off for one person, or for one type of email, if you know something the system does not. What happens when another agent enquires on my listing?
It is detected automatically, tagged in red, and it never costs you a credit. It is also excluded from every automated email, so we are not sending a homeowner valuation to a co-broker. The tag is a warning rather than a deletion, with one click to remove it if we get it wrong. What if I do not switch Automation on?
The Nurture board still fills up. Every closed deal still puts the contact on it and the data is still collected, but nothing sends, and a counter shows you what would have gone out that month. If you switch it on later, the machine starts already loaded rather than from nothing.

## Free to run your agency. You pay when we bring you a buyer.

The MLS, the CRM, unlimited listings and unlimited staff accounts cost nothing. Turn on the parts that work while you sleep whenever
they are worth it to you. A connected inbox puts the client’s replies on the contact they
belong to, without you copying anything across.

Create your free agency account

# How billing works

What you pay for on PropertyList and when: credit packs, monthly subscriptions, pay-as-you-go, and renewals.
PropertyList runs on a simple credit balance. Everything paid is drawn from a single pot of credits, so there is only one thing to keep an eye on. This page explains what you pay for and when.

## Buying credits

You buy credits in packs. Bigger packs are better value. Prices are in euro and VAT is added at checkout.

You pay | You get | Works out at |
€20 | 20 credits | €1.00 / credit |
€47 | 50 credits | €0.94 / credit |
€90 | 100 credits | €0.90 / credit |
€425 | 500 credits | €0.85 / credit |
€800 | 1,000 credits | €0.80 / credit |

Credits you have bought stay in your balance until you use them - they never expire.

## Two kinds of charge

- Monthly subscriptions - features you keep switched on, billed once a month from your credits: your website, Instant Content, and any add-ons. Your billing page always shows what is included and the monthly total.

- Pay as you go - one-off things charged only when you use them, from the same balance: market reports, extra listing photos, private listings (first 5 free, then 5 credits each), and so on. Nothing recurring.

## Your monthly subscriptions

Turn any of these on or off whenever you like - the total updates straight away. You only pay for what you switch on; a typical site is the 50-credit base and the rest are optional.

Subscription | Per month | What it gives you |
Website Builder | 50 credits | Your own website: results page, property pages, and your first few pages |
Each extra page | 10 credits | Beyond the pages included in the base |
Instant Content | 30 credits | Unlimited AI blog posts and area guides - fully automated or review-first |
Custom domain | 20 credits | Your own web address instead of a PropertyList one |
Remove PropertyList branding | 50 credits | A clean site with no "Powered by" mark |
Pop-up lead capture | 8 credits | A contact pop-up to catch enquiries |
Auto meta / SEO | 5 credits | Search-engine tags written for you |
Monthly report | 5 credits | A summary of your site's month, emailed to you |
AI FAQ | 8 credits | An AI question-and-answer block on your pages |

## Renewals

- A few days before your renewal, we email you a reminder listing exactly what you are paying for and the total.

- On renewal day the credits come out of your balance and you are set for another month. We email you a receipt.

- If your balance is too low to cover it, your custom site pauses and visitors see the standard page instead. Nothing is lost - every page and setting is kept safe as a draft.

- Top up your credits and republish in one click, and you are straight back live.

## Auto-Renew: set it once, never go offline

Auto-Renew is how you pay for credits automatically so your monthly subscriptions never lapse. On your billing page, save a card and tick Auto-renew my subscriptions: if your balance is short the day before renewal we top it up automatically by exactly what is due, so nothing pauses or expires. It is a payment method, not an extra charge and not a bonus scheme. Cards are held securely by Stripe; PropertyList never sees or stores your full card number.

## Quick answers

- When am I charged? Subscriptions once a month on your renewal day; pay-as-you-go only at the moment you use it. Both from your credit balance.

- Do credits expire? Credits you have bought never expire. Occasional promotional credits may - we always say so when we give them.

- Can I cancel? Any time. Switch a feature off and it will not renew next month; the current month stays active until your renewal date, with no refunds for a part-month.

- How do I see what I am paying for? Your billing page shows every active subscription, its credit cost, your monthly total and your next renewal date. Reminder and receipt emails show the same breakdown.

### Next steps

- How referrals work
- Using & earning credits - what credits buy and how to earn them free.

# Community Guidelines

The standards every agent agrees to on PropertyList: accurate listings, fair collaboration, honest marketing, respectful community conduct, and how to report a problem.
PropertyList works because agents trust each other. These guidelines keep the platform fair, accurate and useful for everyone - agents, agencies, and the buyers and renters who rely on our listings. By using PropertyList you agree to follow them.

## 1. Keep your listings real and accurate

- Only list properties you are genuinely instructed to market.

- Keep the details accurate - price, location, size, photos and description should reflect the real property.

- No duplicate listings for the same property.

- Remove or update a listing as soon as it is sold, let or withdrawn.

- Never invent or exaggerate prices, features or availability.

## 2. Collaborate in good faith

The MLS only works if agents share fairly.

- Honour any collaboration terms and commission splits you agree with another agent.

- Respect the relationship between another agent and their client - do not go around them or poach their client.

- Respond to genuine enquiries and viewing requests promptly and professionally.

## 3. Market honestly

- Be truthful in every listing, message and advert.

- Do not use misleading prices, fake urgency, or claims you cannot back up.

- Follow the Spanish advertising and consumer rules that apply to property.

## 4. Be a good member of the community

This applies to our WhatsApp groups, forums and any shared space.

- Share real listings and genuine client requests. No spam, floods or repeated self-promotion.

- Stay on topic and keep it professional.

- Treat every member with respect. No harassment, discrimination or abuse of any kind.

## 5. Protect client and agent data

- Handle personal data lawfully and in line with GDPR - see our data protection guidance.

- Do not scrape, copy or misuse other agents' listings or contacts.

- Only contact people who expect to hear from you.

## 6. Report a problem

If you see a fake listing, a scam, or an agent breaking these guidelines, tell us. Reports are confidential.

Report a problem or a scam ->

## What happens if the guidelines are broken

We would rather help than penalise, so a first issue usually means a friendly heads-up. Serious or repeated breaches can lead to a listing being removed, losing access to community groups, or an account being suspended, and can affect Verified Agency status. These guidelines sit alongside our Terms and Conditions.

Thank you for helping keep PropertyList a platform agents can trust.

# What's on, town by town

Real, verified events - concerts, ferias, exhibitions, markets and beach days - pulled from official sources and
refreshed every week. Pick your town, tap + Add to plan on anything you like, share the plan
with your friends or travel partners, and drop it straight into your calendar. Free, no signup.

## Marbella

Starlite nights, ferias, street markets and the famous beach clubs.
10 events on now and coming up · updated 14 September See the Marbella diary ->

## Estepona

The flower-filled old town, the port after dark and the summer festival season.
7 events on now and coming up · updated 14 September See the Estepona diary ->

## Malaga

City culture, Michelin stars, chiringuito beaches and clubs open until dawn.
34 events on now and coming up · updated 14 September See the Malaga diary ->

Run a venue or organise events in another Costa del Sol town? Register your event or feed
- new towns launch where the diary fills up.

# About us
URL: https://info.propertylist.es/about-us/

About PropertyList

# Built for Agents. Not to Compete With Them.

For years, you have been forced to operate within a broken system. You pay exorbitant subscription fees to corporate platforms, only to watch
them use your own data against you. Listings are duplicated or not real, marketing budgets are stretched to the limit, and the very leads you
work hard to generate are often sold right back to your competitors.

It is time to take your power back.

PropertyList was created with one uncompromising belief: real estate agents should not have to fund the platforms that are actively trying to
replace them. We are redefining real estate by delivering the industry’s first-ever fusion of true MLS efficiency and high-level property
portal visibility.

Agents: Get Started FREE

Developers: Get Started FREE

No credit card required.

## Why We Exist

We looked at the modern real estate landscape and refused to accept the status quo. We saw:

- Agents paying thousands per year with absolutely zero platform loyalty in return.
- A complete lack of a centralised, tech-forward infrastructure built exclusively for the agent network.
- Rigid, locked-in contracts designed to trap agencies rather than help them grow.
- Corporate portals hijacking exclusive mandates just to sell the leads back to the highest bidder.

## What We Built

Instead of adding another expensive trap to the market, we built a strategic infrastructure designed to give you absolute control.

Smart MLS Automated CRM Public Portal Pay-as-you-go Credits

## The Agent-First Approach

PropertyList is built to protect your pipeline, not drain your marketing budget. The Smart MLS and the automated CRM are free at the
core: unlimited property uploads, unlimited staff accounts, and no hidden fees, no setup fees and no cancellation fees.

We operate on a foundation of absolute transparency:

### You own your listings

We guarantee an exclusive protection window for every buyer lead generated from the PropertyList.es Public Portal on your specific listing
mandate. Unlike traditional portals, we will never instantly hijack your hard-earned buyer and sell them to the highest bidder. You hold
the exclusive first right to open and claim that direct lead, and opening it costs nothing today.

To maintain a high standard of service for property seekers, if a lead remains unopened and inactive for 5 working days, our automated
system will redirect the buyer to a duplicate or similar property to ensure their inquiry is answered. Your active leads and your listings
remain strictly in your control.

### A collaborative New Development network

We actively partner with property developers, allowing them to list their projects on our infrastructure at absolutely no cost. This feeds
high-value, commissionable inventory directly into your network for you to sell, while our public portal operates as an independent channel
to drive massive market exposure.

### You only pay for what you use

We have eliminated tied contracts, setup fees, cancellation fees, and hidden costs. You operate on a flexible, pay-as-you-go credit system.
You only invest when you strategically choose to unlock premium tools, such as featuring listings or generating AI-powered market reports. Opening a
direct lead from the public portal is free for a limited time.

## Our Vision & Mission: A Complete Real Estate Ecosystem

At PropertyList, we are on a mission to revolutionise the housing market - creating an inclusive space where everyone discovers quality
homes, receives unwavering support, and accesses top-rated services. Our commitment is to connect buyers, sellers, renters and estate agents.

But we are not stopping there. We are building a comprehensive digital ecosystem that connects you directly with essential property
professionals and tradesmen, including lawyers, architects, plumbers, and dedicated builders.

## Innovation That Helps You Win

We are also constantly exploring new technological frontiers. From AI tools to automation and smart funnels, we build things that
take work off your desk and make the experience better for the client on the other end.

## Join the Movement

The industry is shifting, and the smartest agencies are already securing their positions. Today, PropertyList is trusted by 1,000+ agencies
and 1,390+ active agents across Spain, with 6,130+ properties actively listed.

If you are ready to step into a professional network designed to protect your deals, reduce your costs, and amplify your success - rather
than compete with you - you are exactly where you need to be.
